limitations: No orbit classification, quotient isomorphism classification or Betti tables.
Binary q=2 incidence distribution is previously known.
Potential coverage by general-q projective-line classifications remains a residual risk.
scientific_integrity: The proof is included and characteristic-uniform. The binary q=2 specialization is covered in Shaw-Maks-Gordon (2005); the contribution claimed is the uniform four-strata count for all prime powers. Some broader orbit-count literature might imply parts. Independent validation not performed.
title: Four Hilbert-series strata for two quadratic relations in a five-generator exterior algebra over finite fields
